---
title: "shinyapps.io rejects an app name that contains a dot"
ref: SHY-07
categories: [Shiny]
impact: cryptique
attendu: "an app published under the name `my.app`"
versions: "All versions of {rsconnect}"
source: "Slack ThinkR (2024)"
---

::: {.piege .piege-statique}
```r
rsconnect::deployApp(appDir = ".", appName = "my.app")
```
:::

This pitfall depends on a shinyapps.io account and the network, so it cannot be replayed in the browser.

## Why

A shinyapps.io app name may only contain letters, digits, hyphens and underscores. The dot, common in R package and folder names, is not allowed.

The rejection only comes at deployment time, once the app bundle has been prepared, with a message about the name rather than the code. The pitfall keeps coming back when the name is built automatically from the package or folder name.

## The remedy

Give an explicit, compliant name, without a dot, independent of the folder name.

::: {.piege .piege-statique}
```r
rsconnect::deployApp(appDir = ".", appName = "my-app")
```
:::
